AskSet.objective: Create a tiny safe Python CLI program that adds two integers and prints JSON evidence. Keep it self-contained and testable.
AskSet.outline: Files: app.py, test_app.py, README.md. No network. No mutation outside workspace.

selected_template.rationale: Data/report cues imply a CLI transformer with sample input and JSON evidence output.

TestSet.subsystem_evaluation: analyze and compare holistic subsystem performance (e.g., IO, memory, throughput) to propose architecture-level upgrades rather than localized patches
TestSet.debugger: extract traceback/error evidence and feed bounded repair hints into the next mutation
TestSet.decompile_compile_hook: reserved for Binary Ninja/Ghidra/JDK/D8 adapters when installed and approved

scientific_sandbox.action: Isolate logic block, run in clean virtual environment, collect telemetry, report to SystemComparisonMatrix.

live_system_mutation.constraint: One physical change per 20-min cycle. 100% verified success required before merge.

DebuggerSet.binary_adapter: reserved for Binary Ninja/Vector35 debugger or other approved debugger toolchains
